classification.difficultyReason: Match the journey distances and displayed included angle to the direct route.

inlines.text: Ruby drives along a 14 km track from point
She then turns and travels 19 km to point
Calculate the distance from her starting point. Answer correct to one decimal place.

spec.description: Blue-teal triangle with A right of B on a horizontal baseline and C above and slightly left of B. Mid-segment travel arrows point A to B and B to C. Grey dashed baseline extends left of B. Black vertex labels and black interior angle arc.
spec.mathematics: Interior angle ABC is 103 degrees. AB and BC are unlabelled in the figure; lengths 14 km and 19 km occur only in the stem. AC is the unlabelled required distance.
